scope: Fresh raw B-defined task; no force gate or new DFT. Unique novel hits are deduplicated within each 128-proposal request/seed pool and averaged; cross-request unique graph counts are separate. Shuffled controls exactly permute the same conditional inputs and random streams, so are not independent new proposals. B is both training target and acceptance, not independent accuracy.

input_contract.padding: group by canonical per-molecule padded length, matching train/inference

predictor.role: Same fixed B defines training labels, rewards and success; not independent DFT truth
